content: function UpdatePersistency [SWS_PER_00357] Upstream: RS_PER_00013 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < void > UpdatePersistency () noexcept; Updates all Persistency Key-Value Storages and File Storages after a new Target Configuration was installed. This method can be used to update the persistent data of the Adaptive Application during verification phase. Header-Datei #include "ara/per/update.h" class mono Scope namespace ara::per class mono Exception-Sicherheit exception safe class mono Thread-Sicherheit not thread-safe class mono Rückgabewert th Typ th Beschreibung td ara::core::Result < void > td A Result of void. In case of an error, it contains any of the errors defined below, or a vendor specific error. Fehler th Fehlercode th Beschreibung td kPhysicalStorage-Failure td no_rollback_semantics Returned if access to the physical storage fails during the update operation. td kIntegrityCor-rupted td rollback_semantics Returned if stored data cannot be read because the structural integrity is corrupted. td kValidationFailed td rollback_semantics Returned if the validity of stored data cannot be ensured. td kEncryptionFailed td rollback_semantics Returned if the encryption or decryption of stored data fails during the update operation. td kResourceBusy td rollback_semantics Returned if ara::per::CleanUpPersistency or ara::per :: ResetPersistency is currently being executed, or if ara:: per::RecoverKeyValueStorage or ara::per :: ResetKeyValueStorage is currently being executed for any Key-Value Storage, or if ara::per::RecoverAllFiles or ara::per::ResetAllFiles is currently being executed for any File Storage, or a ara::per::SharedHandle of a Key- Value Storage or a File Storage is currently in use. td kOutOfStorageSpace td no_rollback_semantics Returned if the available physical storage space is insufficient for the update. td kTooManyFiles td rollback_semantics Returned if the files added during the update of any File Storage would exceed the configured PersistencyFileStorageInterface.maxNumberOfFiles. td kQuotaExceeded td rollback_semantics Returned if the update would exceed the configured PersistencyCommon.MaximumAllowedSize of any Key- Value Storage or File Storage. td kAuthentication-Failed td rollback_semantics Returned if calculating or checking the MAC of stored data fails.
